name: Minako no Suiyoubi
source:
Every Wednesday tutor Minako comes over. Main character has big plans for her, and these plans are to be implemented today with her arrival.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
每个星期三导师美奈子都会过来。主角对她有一个宏伟的计划，这些计划将在今天随着她的到来而实施。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-december-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
